text: Residential property owners aged 60 years and above occupying self-owned premises are eligible for a 15% annual property tax rebate upon submitting age proof and Aadhaar-linked property assessment ID. Additionally, all taxpayers settling full annual dues on or before April 30 receive a 5% early-bird prompt payment discount.

section: Section 48(3) - Late Payment Penalty & Digital Receipt
text: Property tax payments made after the half-yearly due dates (September 30 and March 31) attract simple interest at 1.5% per month on the unpaid principal balance. Instant digitally signed receipts are generated upon UPI, net-banking, or municipal facilitation center settlement.

section: Section 12 - Micro & Retail Trade License Fees
text: Retail establishments up to 500 sq. ft. require a Category-C Municipal Trade License with an annual fee of INR 1,500. Required documents include valid property tax receipt, rental/lease agreement or ownership deed, FSSAI registration (for food outlets), and fire safety self-declaration. Applications are processed within 7 working days.

section: Schedule II - Road Pothole & Streetlight Restoration SLAs
text: Under the Smart City Citizen Service Charter, arterial road potholes classified as HIGH severity must be cold-patched or resurfaced within 24 hours of ticket verification. Non-functional LED streetlights must be restored within 48 hours, while open manholes or collapsed culverts carry a mandatory 4-hour emergency barricade and repair SLA.

Households and commercial establishments must segregate wet biodegradable waste (green bin) and dry recyclable waste (blue bin) at source. Missed garbage collection complaints logged before 11:00 AM are cleared the same day by 5:00 PM. Illegal dumping of construction debris on public roads incurs a spot fine of INR 5,000.

section: Clause 19 - Domestic Connection & Pipeline Leak Response
text: New domestic water supply connections require a one-time road-cutting and meter installation fee of INR 3,200 for a 15mm ferrule connection. Major trunk pipeline bursts and sewage overflow incidents carry a 12-hour containment and restoration SLA, with emergency water tankers dispatched free of charge to affected wards.

doc_title: Smart City Public Transit & Mobility Pass Guidelines 2026
section: Section 7 - Unified Smart Mobility Card & Student Concessions
text: The One-City Smart Mobility Card provides seamless tap-and-go fare integration across municipal electric buses and metro feeder shuttles with a 10% flat fare discount. Full-time students enrolled in accredited universities receive a 50% monthly pass concession upon institutional ID verification.
